summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge: analyze Soony's confidential launch data, find where the Collector's Edition and Standard Edition miss the Sunday 20:00 deadline, and build a general recheck-and-act agent product (polling loop, extraction, recompute, supplier emails with approval) plus a UI, ready for the 12:00 hand-in.
summary.outcome: Found hidden problems the plan marked ok (overbooked art book receipt, failed statue lot, sleeve revision conflict, airline offload of game cards). Built the ask_soony app with versioned poller, agents, outbox sync with duplicate-send guard, drop-drill fixes, routine diagram redesign and list-scrolling fixes, all committed locally on jonas/today-flow. Briefing pages and interview doc were created. Pushing, README, demo script and video are still pending, and a decided-row scroll-reset fix is in progress.

repo: Portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip) with no webhooks. Files get replaced under the same name, so change detection must compare SHA-256 per file, not just new filenames.
Confidential portal data lives in gitignored data/. .env is gitignored and .env.example is committed with an empty token.

The team shares one mailbox. Emails sent by hand or by teammate code (Lucas's Pulse console on origin/new-approach) are invisible to the app unless it reads the sent folder, which led to a double order to Karton Nowak.
Pulse console sends to whatever recipient is in the request with no supplier allow-list. The app uses cardtools.supplier_addresses()/known_addresses() as an allow-list.
Replies to side emails must not mark a case as decided. They add information only. Treating them as sent wrongly dropped three cases out of 'Needs you'.

Drop drill found: renamed columns auto-resolved real cards, the predictor and papercheck wrote the same impacts file in different shapes (pipeline crash), the older tracker version won over the newer, and any address in a supplier profile was trusted as a send target. All fixed.
The team workflow is in CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md. Claim tasks in PROGRESS.md before building.

Commit b0cff82 accidentally included api.py edits importing an untracked supplier_master.py. Check git status for untracked dependencies before committing, since the live server runs from the working folder and masks this.

code.finding: New module that syncs the shared mailbox's sent folder to cases. Matching goes by thread reference, then supplier plus order number, then a part number unique to one case. It feeds a 12-hour duplicate-send guard that returns 409 unless the user chooses 'Send anyway'.
New module that compares newer supplier profile JSON (status, qualification, expiry, contact) against profile.csv and raises cards. New contact emails are not used as send targets until confirmed.

Routine diagram rewritten as n8n-style nodes (When / one 'Only if' node / one node per Then step). Funnel counts come from funnel.ts and are computed in the browser, so they can drift from routines.py.

workflow: Subagents work well for bulk cross-checking (200 order confirmations and 59 scans), drop rehearsals on a copy of state, and UX reviews with screenshots. Run them against copied state with LLM calls and background jobs off.
Rehearse drops on a copy of portal/state/store with ASK_REPLY_POLL=off, ASK_TEAMS=off and ASK_LLM_PROVIDER=none so nothing polls the real portal or sends mail.
Entire only writes a checkpoint when repo files change, so 'no files modified, skipping checkpoint' is normal during read-only analysis.
Verify UI fixes in a headless browser (for example press J seven times, or click a row and measure scroll) rather than relying on typecheck alone.

friction: The portal token was initially empty, which blocked data access until the user added it.
Shared mailbox caused a duplicate 8,000-book order (06:50 from the app, 07:04 by hand signed Paul Winter) and left the app unaware of it.
Teammate's Pulse code sent unvetted emails to Hwaseong and to an external Gmail address (it bounced).
My commit b0cff82 picked up uncommitted work and would not have started on its own.
Reply handling wrongly closed three cases, which had to be reopened.
The claim sentence rendered awkwardly: wrong wording for computed cases, and a stray period because of block-level buttons.
Chosen recommendation option had no key number and was not clickable.
The left case list did not scroll with the selection, and picking a 'Decided by you' entry reset the scroll (349 to 32). The whole Today view appears to rebuild when a case opens.
Wording between the UX expert's list version and the user's n8n-card preference needed another redesign round.
open_items: Push the 15 local commits on jonas/today-flow (awaiting user approval).
Finish the scroll-reset fix when a decided case is selected, which was being retested.
Builder for 'confirmed orders become inbound deliveries' (art books arrive ~19:30 vs cell dry at ~11:16) is still running. It needs review and commit.
Decide whether to combine the four 'Are there really…?' count questions into one case (17 cases in Needs you).
Send a note to Hwaseong about the three Pulse test emails, and draft a message to Lucas about the Pulse allow-list.
App sends every costed case to Maren. It should use policy approval limits (Paul Winter up to 50k EUR).
Memo rules (Quality & Compliance last word, air/rush to CPO within the hour) are extracted but not used for routing.
Real predictor (news impact) run is untested and defaults to gpt-5, which costs money. A renamed stock column is only signalled by the datacheck warning.
Hand-in at 12:00: README, demo script and video still missing.
Register sender addresses in the portal Settings and ask Lio whether portal data is identical across teams and whether supplier replies create portal files.
Codex hooks need approval via /hooks. Change the portal login password after the hack, since it was shared in Discord.
Decide whether to delete the older Claude doc now that the briefing page exists.
